useful_god.rationale: Day Master Metal is strong; Water balances the chart.

yogas.name: Gaja-Kesari
yogas.reason: Jupiter is in the 9th sign from the Moon; Gaja-Kesari needs the 1st, 4th, 7th or 10th.

yogas.name: Budha-Aditya
yogas.reason: Sun and Mercury are both in Sagittarius.

yogas.name: Chandra-Mangala
yogas.reason: Moon is in Gemini and Mars in Cancer; Chandra-Mangala needs both in the same sign.

yogas.name: Ruchaka
yogas.reason: Mars is in Cancer, neither its own sign (Aries, Scorpio) nor its exaltation sign (Capricorn).

yogas.name: Bhadra
yogas.reason: Mercury is in Sagittarius, neither its own sign (Gemini, Virgo) nor its exaltation sign (Virgo).

yogas.name: Hamsa
yogas.reason: Jupiter is in Aquarius, neither its own sign (Sagittarius, Pisces) nor its exaltation sign (Cancer).

yogas.name: Malavya
yogas.reason: Venus is in Sagittarius, neither its own sign (Taurus, Libra) nor its exaltation sign (Pisces).

yogas.name: Sasa
yogas.reason: Saturn is in Virgo, neither its own sign (Capricorn, Aquarius) nor its exaltation sign (Libra).

yogas.name: Harsha
yogas.reason: The 6th house is Aquarius; its lord Saturn is in the 1st house; Harsha needs the 6th, 8th or 12th.

yogas.name: Sarala
yogas.reason: The 8th house is Aries; its lord Mars is in the 11th house; Sarala needs the 6th, 8th or 12th.

yogas.name: Vimala
yogas.reason: The 12th house is Leo; its lord Sun is in the 4th house; Vimala needs the 6th, 8th or 12th.

yogas.name: Neecha Bhanga
yogas.reason: Mars is debilitated in Cancer; cancelled because (a) Moon, lord of Cancer, is in a kendra (10th from the Lagna and 1st from the Moon); (b) Saturn, lord of Capricorn (Mars's exaltation sign), is in a kendra (1st from the Lagna and 4th from the Moon).

yogas.name: Sunapha
yogas.reason: 2nd from the Moon (Cancer): Mars; 12th from the Moon (Taurus): none (Sun, Rahu and Ketu do not count).

yogas.name: Anapha
yogas.reason: 2nd from the Moon (Cancer): Mars; 12th from the Moon (Taurus): none (Sun, Rahu and Ketu do not count).

yogas.name: Durudhara
yogas.reason: 2nd from the Moon (Cancer): Mars; 12th from the Moon (Taurus): none (Sun, Rahu and Ketu do not count).

yogas.name: Kemadruma
yogas.reason: 2nd from the Moon (Cancer): Mars; 12th from the Moon (Taurus): none (Sun, Rahu and Ketu do not count); Kemadruma means both are empty.

yogas.name: Vesi
yogas.reason: 2nd from the Sun (Capricorn): none; 12th from the Sun (Scorpio): none (Moon, Rahu and Ketu do not count).

yogas.name: Vasi
yogas.reason: 2nd from the Sun (Capricorn): none; 12th from the Sun (Scorpio): none (Moon, Rahu and Ketu do not count).

yogas.name: Ubhayachari
yogas.reason: 2nd from the Sun (Capricorn): none; 12th from the Sun (Scorpio): none (Moon, Rahu and Ketu do not count).

yogas.name: Subha Kartari
yogas.reason: Natural benefics (Jupiter, Venus, Mercury) in the 2nd house: none; in the 12th: none. Subha Kartari needs both houses occupied by them (the Moon is not counted).

yogas.name: Papa Kartari
yogas.reason: Natural malefics (Sun, Mars, Saturn, Rahu, Ketu) in the 2nd house: none; in the 12th: none. Papa Kartari needs both houses occupied by them (the Moon is not counted).

yogas.name: Parivartana
yogas.reason: No two planets stand in each other's signs.

yogas.name: Mangal Dosha
yogas.reason: Mars is 11th from the Lagna, 2nd from the Moon and 8th from Venus; the dosha houses are the 1st, 2nd, 4th, 7th, 8th and 12th.

yogas.name: Kala Sarpa
yogas.reason: Planets lie on both sides of the Rahu–Ketu axis: Moon and Jupiter on one, Sun, Mars, Mercury, Venus and Saturn on the other.

yogas.name: Amala
yogas.reason: Natural benefics (Jupiter, Venus, Mercury) in the 10th from the Lagna (Gemini): none; in the 10th from the Moon (Pisces): none.

yogas.name: Dhana
yogas.reason: The 2nd lord Venus and the 11th lord Moon are linked: Venus in Sagittarius and Moon in Gemini aspect each other.

yogas.name: Dharma-Karmadhipati
yogas.reason: The 9th lord Venus and the 10th lord Mercury are linked: Venus and Mercury are both in Sagittarius.

yogas.name: Nakshatra Parivartana
yogas.reason: No two bodies occupy each other's nakshatras; nakshatra lords: Sun Venus, Moon Rahu, Mars Mercury, Mercury Venus, Jupiter Mars, Venus Venus, Saturn Moon, Rahu Sun, Ketu Jupiter.
